title: Obedience and remembrance belong together
summary: This is not service as activity only. It is inward obedience and inward Naam.
lifeApplication: Ask whether your effort today is actually aligned with Guru's direction or merely energetic.

source.shortMeaning: The Guru's servant is shaped by obedience and remembrance together.
source.lifeApplication: Let your outer work be held by inner remembrance.

evidence.coreClaim: The Guru's servant is shaped by obedience and remembrance together.
evidence.turn: Seva becomes transformative when the self stops trying to be seen through it.
evidence.practicalImplication: Ask whether your effort today is actually aligned with Guru's direction or merely energetic.
